## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix

## Checklist

- [ ] Tokens only: no raw `Color`, `Font` or `CGFloat` values; colors come from `@DSThemed`
- [ ] No existing public parameter changed its label or position
- [ ] `#Preview` in light and dark on `.dsBackdrop()`, plus a `ComponentCatalog` section
- [ ] Docs updated: `docs/components/<Name>.md`, `docs/components.md` or `docs/tokens.md`
- [ ] Line in `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] VoiceOver label, value and traits; Reduce Motion and Reduce Transparency honored
- [ ] `swift build`, `swift test` and the iOS `xcodebuild` pass locally
